subject: health
unitTitle: Sexual Health, Safety, and Community Wellbeing
essentialQuestion: How can understanding sexual health, safety, and community wellbeing help us explain, decide, create, or solve something that matters?

prompts.prompt: Explain puberty and reproductive-system concepts in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, quotation, data display, map, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of personal boundaries and consent.
Apply infection prevention concepts in a new realistic situation. Show the process or cite evidence.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, unsafe choice, or design flaw involving reliable adults and services; correct it and explain why.
Connect puberty and reproductive-system concepts with community health advocacy. Explain how the ideas support, constrain, contrast with, or build on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: Complete an age-appropriate, fact-based safety and advocacy project with a private question channel and family review option.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or quality, and one next question.

neverRequires: This task never requires body weight, height, BMI, or body-fat percentage.
